method: Read the existing telemetry rows. Construct mathematical box vertices and the exact existing 20-segment Cylinder vertices, transform with recorded pose and steering, and compare static authored box AABBs. No RoadsterSim instance, world, world.step, replay, new contacts, forces, browser or source mutation is created.
limits: rigidContactCount includes all 8 compound shapes; 4 wheel-bump-stop cylinders are not excluded. Count is not a chassis-only contact count.

Actual Cannon contact object IDs, vehicleShape IDs, contact normals, penetration and contact multipliers are not present in these telemetry rows. Missing values remain unknown. Existing getContactDiagnostics was not captured at these times.
wheelStates.contactObjectId refers to suspension support. integration.objectId is a broadphase refinement trigger, not actual contact provenance.
Geometric lowest vertices and static AABB overlap are a post-hoc mathematical interpretation of recorded poses, not reconstructed contact equations or measured contact forces.
The observation is configured ideal/no noise and retains the last pre-integration slice pose. The ordinary telemetry position is after that slice; these are not identical instants.
The static candidate list contains the authored city/street records plus global ground. Legacy special test geometry is far from these event locations and not included in this local list.

1244 telemetry samples are sparse relative to 120 Hz physics. 25 observations are not 25 unique contact events or the duration of every contact. Microstep counters cover only the sampled outer control steps.
Filtered gLoad includes normal suspension, steering, braking and acceleration; it cannot isolate hard-contact impulse severity or injury/damage.
